> Found across Venix, these ancient ruins have many different runes carved into them. Significant disagreement among scholars if it’s a very old language or encoded magic. [[Lacrimiteres Party#Isolde|Isolde's]] father dedicated his studies to them and other ancient artifacts and their magical properties


## Lore
>The ancient magic these ruins are steeped in will cause temporary blindness when a "detect magic" spell is used on them. The magic can also cause odd occurrences. Possibly an ancient language but can't be deciphered using magic

>[[Lord Hux]] seems to have some information on the runes themselves; he worked closely with Isolde's father in the past. Believed to be able to at least partially read the runes

>[[Balm Sure#Auction House Dirty Deeds|Laurie]] is looking to be an archeologist and specialize in ruins and their runes; heard there are 1 or 2 people who can read it, but no one has published any formal translations

___
